title: Permitted uses in Manufacturing Districts
previewText:
In all Manufacturing Districts, in addition to the uses specified in Article IV, Chapter 2, the following uses shall also be permitted:

uses listed under Use Group III(B); and uses listed under Food and Beverage Retailers in Use Group VI, without limitation as to floor area per establishment.
